story_structure.value: The Channel Map, declared in the script doc BEFORE drafting (N-04): ORIENT (what this place is) → SHOW ONE (the planet's story, compressed to its arc) → SHOW TWO (words in five languages) → PROMISE (plain statement) → MAKING (the brand beat) → FAMILY (relationship line) → ASK (spoken CTA), bookended by two silent cards — the opening card (EARTH ONE over the banner's timeline landscape, 1.6 s) and the end card (the same landscape, now labelled with the two shows). A trailer's job is navigation, not a single teaching arc — the map IS the structure, declared here before drafting per N-04. The bookend is load-bearing per the doc's own removal test: without the end-card return, the spoken 'start with episode one' points nowhere visible.
